hook: Google Will Make AI Agents Use Its MCP Servers.
hookText: Google Will Make AI Agents Use Its MCP Servers.

beats.say: Google is moving its Workspace AI agents onto its own MCP servers, with one catch: the Gmail agent can't send email.
On 24 November, Google made its eight Workspace MCP servers generally available and published a new clause in its API terms.
From 1 February 2027, any tool that "is or is driven by an AI Agent" must reach Gmail, Drive, Calendar and the rest of Workspace through those servers.
